## Proportion of missing onset dates where date inferred by Garske et al are in 95% Credible Sets

```{r, echo = FALSE}
onset_missing <- which(is.na(samples$data$onset))
is_in_credible_set <- 
  unlist(lapply(onset_missing, 
                function(i) data_with_onset_inferred$onset_inferred[i] %in%
                  calc_credible_set(samples, i, 1, 0.95)))
sum(is_in_credible_set) / length(is_in_credible_set)
```
